claims.claim_text: The indexed Lieutenant Fillmore H. Sanford is matched at high confidence to the Harvard-trained psychologist of the same rare full name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NARA index and Harvard's institutional alumni list share the rare exact name and middle initial, and the 1941 doctorate fits the documented wartime chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match from a rare exact full name, middle initial and compatible prewar chronology; Box 675 remains necessary for direct personnel-file confirmation.
claims.temporal_assessment: Harvard dates the psychology doctorate to 1941, before the OSS period, but does not state when Sanford entered OSS.
claims.match_notes: The later psychology career is not used to infer an employer immediately before OSS.

claims.claim_text: Fillmore H. Sanford received a psychology doctorate from Harvard University in 1941.
